in_marathi.name: Manav
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Man, human being
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manav हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Manav is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘manava’, meaning ‘man’ or ‘human being’. In Hindu mythology, Manav is considered to be the collective term for all humans. This name symbolizes the essence of humanity and our connection to the universe.
